### Topic 1 formative self-assessment specification

| Item ID | Item type | Objective mapping | Complete question or scenario | Response options / expected response | Correct answer | Feedback for correct response | Feedback for incorrect responses | Supporting citations | Accessible alternative |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F1-01 | multiple choice | LO1 | Which is true? | A. Hazard equals risk.<br>B. Risk depends on the task. | B | Correct. Risk belongs to the task, not only the product. | A: They differ. | [SRC-A] | Radio buttons. |
| F1-02 | multiple response | LO2 | Pick controls. | A. Enclose.<br>B. Substitute.<br>C. Hope. | A and B | Correct. | C is not a control. | [SRC-B] | Checkboxes. |
| F1-03 | matching | LO2 | Match. | 1. Fume hood<br>2. Gloves | 1 → Engineering; 2 → PPE. | Correct. | Swapped. | [SRC-B] | Drop-downs. |
| F1-04 | sequencing | LO2 | Order. | Personal protective equipment; Elimination; Engineering controls. | Elimination → Engineering → PPE. | Correct. | Out of order. | [SRC-B] | Position selectors. |
| F1-05 | categorization | LO1 | Classify. | 1. Solvent is flammable.<br>2. Open heating near ignition.<br>3. Label shows pictogram. | Hazard: 1, 3. Risk: 2. | Correct. | Mixed up. | [SRC-A] | Drop-downs. |
